live.noSessionHelp: Paste a session id into the input on the top-right and press Enter, or open one from the Sessions tab.
live.connectingHelp: Subscribed to the session - telemetry frames should arrive within a few hundred ms once the control loop ticks.

sessions.audioHelp: Audio engine for this session. Auto = derive from EEG source (real BioListener -> on, sim -> off). On/off forces it regardless.
sessions.audioAuto: auto (on for real hardware, off for sim)
sessions.eegSourceHelp: Where EEG samples come from. NMM = mathematical brain model running locally; BioListener = real EEG device on the LAN.
sessions.eegBiolistener: biolistener - real ESP32 BioListener on LAN
sessions.maskTargetHelp: Where strobe commands go. Virtual = local-process simulator (no LEDs); ESP32 = real strobe mask on the LAN.
sessions.maskEsp32: esp32 - real strobe mask on LAN
sessions.protocolHelp: Experimental condition: RL closed-loop, no-stimulation control, or pre-recorded scripted track.

demo.title: Demo / Open Loop
demo.subtitle: Direct mask + audio control. Nothing here is recorded.
demo.maskAlertBody: The mask is the UDP client - it pings the controller every ~2 s. Power the device on and connect it to the same LAN; no IP entry needed (controller bound to 0.0.0.0:20000).
demo.generativeHelp: BiofeedbackEngine - synth pads + binaural beat, tremolo locked to the strobe Hz. Enabling this mutes the track (no audio overlay); the strobe pattern keeps following the CSV on its original timeline.

protocol.title: Hardware session
protocol.amplitudeScaleHint: From tools/calibrate_amplitude.py on the Session A recording.
protocol.amplitudeScaleMissing: Required for a hardware session: without it the agent reads band powers it never trained on.
protocol.whichHint: A validates the system; B is the experiment.
protocol.armOrderHint: Alternates each night so session drift cancels.
protocol.eegSourceHint: sim drives the neural mass model in-process.
protocol.maskHint: Virtual runs on loopback; the ESP32 announces itself.
protocol.checkpointHint: The same archive every night, or nights cannot be pooled.
protocol.seedHint: Fixes the sweep probe order and the arm assignment.
protocol.audioCuesHint: The only channel to a subject with eyes closed.

health.mongoBody: Sessions, Subjects and every recorded artefact need MongoDB and will fail until it is running. The Hardware session page keeps its state in the daemon and is unaffected.
health.daemonBody: The API is not responding. Nothing on these pages will load until it is back.
